basic_info.description: Experience the epitome of coastal luxury in this exquisitely remodeled Outer Sunset stunner. This 4-bed, 3.5-bath home offers three levels of refined elegance and comfort. The grand foyer opens into expansive living spaces featuring opulent finishes and a stunning oversized electric fireplace, setting a warm, sophisticated tone. The gourmet chef's kitchen is a culinary dream with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, waterfall countertops, and a large island perfect for intimate gatherings or lavish soirees.  Upstairs, the serene primary suite boasts a luxurious ensuite with double sinks, an oversized shower, a custom walk-in closet, and access to a private deck. Three additional bedrooms offer flexibility, with one en-suite enjoying ocean views and a walk-in closet. Outside, the terraced backyard features a sprawling deck, perfect for alfresco dining or soaking in the ocean breeze and sunset views.  With a 2-car tandem garage, easy access to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and the shops and dining on Irving and Judah, this home is a rare gem that blends coastal elegance with urban convenience.
